title: Adaptive Prefetch Sandbox — experimentation log & rollout checklist
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Objective: Run a controlled experiment suite that validates combined savings and quality trade-offs from adaptive prefetching (prefix/KV cache), micro-batching heuristics, and per-workload quantization profiles. Success metrics: 20% average reduction in per-token GPU time for targeted workloads without >3% degr. in task-level quality (ROUGE / BLEU / human eval where applicable), telemetry for error spike rate <0.5% and SLO adherence >= 99%% for p95 latency in the pilot cohort. Scope: 4-week sandbox with 3 customer-like workloads (chat agents, search rerank, and long-context summarization), three model variants (base, q4_0, q4_1), and two prefetch policies (static window, workload-adaptive). Deliverables: experiment matrix and raw telemetry, analysis notebook, canary rollout checklist, rollback playbook, PRD for scaling to Dedicated plans.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Demonstrated aggregate TPU/GPU token-cost reduction >=20%% on sandbox workloads; 2) Per-workload quality regression <=3%% measured via automated evals and spot human checks; 3) Dashboard with cost/latency/quality per-policy; 4) Canary rollout plan and safety gates approved by SRE and Security; 5) Playbook for customer opt-out and explicit model pinning.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Cache prefetch causes stale KV collisions for streaming sessions -> Mitigation: short TTL per session, strict sequence validation and conservative default policy. Risk: Quantization introduces hallucination increase on instruction-following prompts -> Mitigation: restrict q4_0 to low-risk workloads and enable fallbacks to FP16 for flagged prompts. Risk: Autoscale interactions cause unexpected latency spikes -> Mitigation: add traffic shaping and per-route capacity reservations during canary.
comments: 2025-02-12 Maya Thompson: Created ticket and scoped pilot. Initial hypotheses: (1) adaptive prefetch will reduce cold-KV misses by 45%%, (2) micro-batching up to 8 requests will trade latency for 18-25%% throughput gains for batched workloads.

2025-02-21 Lena Rodriguez (SRE): Reviewed canary rollback steps; requested explicit failure detectors and PagerDuty runbook. Added requirement: abort canary if p95 latency > SLA by 20%% for 5 consecutive minutes.

2025-02-25 Product review: PM review with Customer Success notes that enterprise customers will require an allowlist for quantized variants. Action: add opt-out switch per customer in Console. Assigned to ENG for API surface.

2025-03-03 Engineering update (Daniel Park): Deployed sandbox infra to staging with static window prefetch and micro-batching runtime flags. Observed expected latency tail increase for batched requests; tuned batching max_wait to 12ms which recovered p95 to target.

2025-03-04 Security review (Arjun Mehta): Scanned impact of prefetched KV on PII surface. Conclusion: low risk with session-scoped TTLs; recommend audit log entries for all prefetch reads. Security approval granted conditioned on audit log implementation.
